question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abstract
solution:
The correct answer is: Concrete

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Abstract **means existing only as an idea, not as a physical thing.

 
 
• Example -* It is hard to imagine an **abstract **idea like ‘eternity’.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Concrete means real or definite; not only existing in the imagination.
 
 
• Example -* Can you give me a **concrete **example of what you mean?*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Abstract**' and 'Concrete' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Auspicious **means suggesting a positive and successful future.
 
• **Belligerent **means unfriendly and aggressive.
 
• **Hilarious **means extremely amusing and causing a lot of laughter.
